outcome: Glycosylated hemoglobin levels in the first trimester
cohort: 369 pregnant women with type 1 DM and 579 pregnant women with type 2 DM in Japan
finding: While there were no significant differences in perinatal outcomes between pregnant women with type 1 DM and type 2 DM, women with type 2 DM had a higher risk of primary cesarean section.
mod_finding: Pre-gestational BMI was associated with the need for primary cesarean section.
